description: List DataCanvas dataframes materialized by treasury_query_dataset, treasury_get_debt, treasury_get_interest_rates, and treasury_get_exchange_rates. Each entry surfaces source tool, query parameters, creation/expiry timestamps, row count, and column schema. Use this tool before treasury_dataframe_query to discover table names and column types. Requires CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=duckdb.

name.description: Optional dataframe table name (df_XXXXX_XXXXX) to describe a single dataframe. Omit to list all active dataframes.

name: treasury_dataframe_describe

dataframes.description: Active dataframes for this tenant, newest first. Empty when none are registered.

items.description: Provenance and schema for one dataframe.
One column declaration in the dataframe schema.

nullable.description: Whether the column permits NULL (all Treasury columns are nullable).

type.description: Canvas column type (VARCHAR, BIGINT, DOUBLE, ...). Treasury API values are VARCHAR.

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 expiry timestamp. Sliding TTL touched on every dataframe op.

max_rows.description: Materialization cap that produced `truncated`, when applicable.

query_params.description: Input parameters the source tool was called with.

source_tool.description: Treasury tool that produced this dataframe.

truncated.description: True when the upstream source had more rows than were materialized.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_unavailable`: CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE is not set to duckdb. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

title: Describe Treasury Dataframes
